description: Look up a U.S. company's official Secretary of State business registration across 28 states (KYB). Returns registration records (status, dates, registered agent). Use the full or partial company name.

companyName.description: Business name (or part of it) to search for

exactMatch.description: Only return exact name matches (case-insensitive). Default false.

maxResultsPerState.description: Cap on records per state (1-200, default 25).

states.description: Two-letter state codes to query (e.g. ["NY","TX"]). Omit for all 28 supported states.

name: business_search
